verdict.rationale: Adyen's docs describe merchant-side integrations that let shoppers buy inside AI agents such as Gemini, ChatGPT and Copilot. These include ACP and UCP checkout flows in which Adyen orchestrates stock, tax, shipping and authorization, an Agentic Cart API so merchants don't integrate with each agent platform separately, a dedicated Google AI Mode/Gemini integration, and product feeds synced to OpenAI and Meta. Missing for 10: no explicit mention of Claude or other named peers among supported surfaces, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of live in-chat purchases.
